I learned the rules first. Now I want to work with the people they are for.

I’m Dhilis Johns: a law and business graduate and European Business Management student, looking for a role in HR.

What an HR team gets

I can read the contract and the room.

I am an advocate enrolled with the Bar Council of Kerala. I hold a dual Bachelor’s in Business Administration and Law, study European Business Management at TH Wildau, and live in Wildau, Germany. I am looking for an HR role.

Fewer legal blind spots

I hold a law degree, I am enrolled as an advocate, and I have resolved contract escalations. Employment questions get a careful first reading from me.

A retention mindset

I spent more than a year keeping clients satisfied at Flyworld. The same habits apply to keeping employees.

Process and numbers

I closed over 100 international accounts in nine months, tracked them in a CRM and analysed them in advanced Excel.

Kerala

It started with a robe.

At the Bar Council of Kerala enrolment function I was handed my certificate and became an advocate. Law taught me that every contract is a promise between people, and that rules only work when someone makes sure they are applied fairly.

The desk

Then I learned how organisations actually run.

My dual Bachelor’s in Business Administration and Law gave me both halves: how a company makes decisions, and what it owes the people involved. I took that into work where every day meant talking to someone with a problem.

Snow

I travel to be a beginner again.

On a mountain nobody cares about your title. You fall, you ask, someone shows you how to stand up. I want to bring that attitude to HR: make the first week at a company feel like someone is there to show you the way. The album below shows who I did it with.

Wildau

Now I am building the next chapter in Germany.

I live in Wildau, Brandenburg, and study European Business Management at TH Wildau, with a focus on European markets, strategic management and sustainable operations. A new country means I know what it feels like to be the new person, and what helps.

Why HR

It is where law, business and people meet.

I can read a contract, run a process, analyse the numbers and sit across from someone in a difficult conversation. I want to use all four to help a company hire well, treat people fairly and keep them.
